items.question: Which organisation prequalified a multi-dose respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccine vial on 9 September 2026?
items.explanation: The World Health Organization announced the prequalification.

items.question: Who was appointed WHO Director-General's Special Envoy for Health Resilience?
items.explanation: WHO announced the appointment of Dr Vanessa Kerry.

items.question: Which two space telescopes were named in NASA's report about far-out Solar System objects that “remember” the past?
items.explanation: NASA's report named the Hubble Space Telescope and James Webb Space Telescope.
